subject: Anthropic Claude Enterprise Inference hooks beta
central_claim: Anthropic's Claude Enterprise Inference hooks beta lets an organization route governed prompts from claude.ai, Cowork and Claude Code to its own HTTPS AI security server before inference, where an allow or deny verdict determines whether the model request proceeds.

selection.reason: Inference hooks move enterprise AI policy enforcement into the pre-inference path for Claude Enterprise surfaces. The change has same-day official release notes plus detailed official docs for availability, request flow, verdict schema, failure handling and limitations. It is directly useful to engineering and security teams deciding whether to govern Claude use through inline DLP/policy servers, while the article avoids unverified claims about security effectiveness.

signals.note: Reviewed recent OpenAI developer blog/API docs/pricing, Anthropic release notes/newsroom/platform docs, Google Gemini API changelog, Qwen blog and Hugging Face registry, DeepSeek Hugging Face/GitHub surfaces, Mistral docs changelog and vLLM/PyTorch release pages. Search snippets and registry listings were used only to discover candidates; article facts were checked against opened primary sources.

Anthropic release notes showed an August 5, 2026 Inference hooks beta and Opus 4.1 retirement. The hooks feature had multiple official docs covering behavior and limitations, making it stronger than a retirement-only item for a technical article.

OpenAI GPT-5.6 price/Fast mode update and August 3 system-card update were reviewed as higher-profile model economics/safety alternatives, but their main release dates were July 30 and August 3 rather than the August 5 same-day window. No X post or search result was used as factual evidence.

alternatives.subject: Anthropic Claude Enterprise Inference hooks beta
alternatives.reason: Published in official release notes on 2026-08-05 with supporting overview, configuration and endpoint docs. The central technical claim is bounded and reaches E2 through multiple primary documentation URLs.

alternatives.subject: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna/Terra price cuts and Fast mode rename
alternatives.reason: Official OpenAI blog, model docs and pricing page clearly verify Luna/Terra prices and Fast mode behavior, and the API economics matter to Korean developers. It was not selected because the main commercial update was dated 2026-07-30 and had lower same-day novelty than Anthropic's August 5 release.

alternatives.subject: OpenAI GPT-5.6 system card August 3 prompt-injection evaluation update
alternatives.reason: The system card change log verifies an August 3 addition of GPT-Red prompt-injection evaluation results. It is technically important but narrower and older than the selected same-day enterprise control-plane change.

alternatives.subject: Anthropic Opus 4.1 API retirement on 2026-08-05
alternatives.reason: Release notes confirm requests to claude-opus-4-1-20250805 now return errors and recommend Opus 5. This is operationally useful but mostly a migration notice rather than a richer technical change.

alternatives.subject: Mistral Leanstral 1.5
alternatives.reason: Mistral changelog verifies the June 30 model release and September 30 retirement date, but it is older and focused on Lean 4 formal proof engineering with limited immediate Korean SW audience relevance.

alternatives.subject: Qwen recent official blog/model registry updates
alternatives.reason: Qwen official blog and Hugging Face registry surfaced Qwen-Image and Qwen3 Thinking/Coder variants, but the opened official blog items were not same-day 2026 releases and did not outrank the selected governance feature.

alternatives.subject: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
alternatives.reason: DeepSeek's official Hugging Face registry showed a recently updated DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 model with public artifacts. It was not selected because the update was several days old and benchmark interpretation would need a separate model-card/report review.

alternatives.subject: Google Gemini API recent changes
alternatives.reason: The Gemini changelog did not show a more recent same-day major model release. The visible June and May items were deprecations, managed agents and GA model updates already older than the selected item.

alternatives.subject: vLLM v0.26.0
alternatives.reason: GitHub release notes provide strong primary evidence for a serving-runtime update, but it was released on 2026-07-27 and had already been considered in recent AI edition history.

reproducibility_notes.summary: The public docs describe how to configure and implement Inference hooks, but verification requires a Claude Enterprise tenant and organization:manage permission. No live endpoint, webhook signature, latency, denial event or Activity Feed entry was produced in this turn.

bounded_numeric_contracts: default verdict timeout is 5 seconds according to Anthropic docs
endpoint response body read limit is 64 KiB according to endpoint docs
deny_reason is at most 500 characters and reference_id is at most 50 characters according to endpoint docs
limitations: These numbers are integration constraints, not evidence of DLP accuracy or prompt-injection robustness.
